readme_excerpt: OpenDataLoader PDF PDF Parser for AI-ready data. Automate PDF accessibility. Deterministic local mode + AI hybrid mode for complex pages. - How accurate is it? — #1 in benchmarks: 0.907 overall, 0.928 table accuracy across 200 real-world PDFs including multi-column and scientific papers.
